params.question: at fixed useful workload, does increasing UNUSED request capacity increase user-space cost?

hypotheses.H1-TP: ThreadPool cost rises with C via resolve_completion O(request_capacity) per await
hypotheses.H1-URING: Uring cost rises more strongly via BOTH resolve_completion O(C) and find_live_router_cookie_ O(C) per CQE
